```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Improve digit display and NA display for kable tables
options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = "")

# Load necessary packages
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(mdsr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

#upload csv
##filters:
#time period: select all
#reference area: select all
#commodity: select all
#policy type: select all
#policy changes: deselect all
#policy description: deselect all
OECD <- read_csv("data/OECD.TAD.ADM,DSD_QDD_TAD_EXP_RESTRIC%40DF_QDD_TAD_EXP_RESTRIC,3.0,filtered,2026-11-09 15-04-43.csv")

#wrangle data so that each case represents a single policy
OECD_policies <- OECD |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(REF_AREA, `Reference area`, COMMODITY, Commodity, POLICY_TYPE, `Policy type`, POLICY_VARIATION, `Policy changes`, TIME_PERIOD),
    names_from = POLICY_DESCRIPTION,
    values_from = OBS_VALUE
    ) |>
  mutate(
    Id = row_number()
    )

#wrangle `OECD_policies` so that each set of policies that are the same type and relate to the same resource in the same year are the same
#make sure to note whether a cases is a restriction or exception
OECD_policies_unique <- OECD_policies |>
  distinct(REF_AREA, `Reference area`, COMMODITY, Commodity, POLICY_TYPE, `Policy type`, TIME_PERIOD) |>
  mutate(
    Restriction_TF = POLICY_TYPE != "NO_RESTRICTION"
  )

#wrangle data so that each case represents a country at a certain year (sum the number of restrictions in a given year for the country to get the total number in that year)
OECD_country_years <- OECD_policies_unique |>
  group_by(REF_AREA, `Reference area`, TIME_PERIOD) |>
  summarize(`Number of Unique Policies on Unique Resource` = sum(Restriction_TF))
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
